```{r}
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(polite)
library(htmltools)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
url <- "https://link.springer.com/search?facet-journal-id=12968&query=machine+learning&content-type=Article&dateFrom=&dateTo=&sortBy=relevance"

page <- read_html(url)

titles <- page |>
  html_elements("a.app-card-open__link") |>
  html_text()

titles

links <- page |>
  html_elements("a.app-card-open__link") |>
  html_attr("href")

links <- paste0("https://link.springer.com", links)

dates <- page |>
  html_elements(".app-card-open__meta") |>
  html_text()
dates_clean <- dates |>
  str_squish()
dates_clean <- dates_clean |>
  str_remove("Open access")
dates_clean <- dates_clean |>
  str_squish()
    
dates_clean

articles <- tibble(
  title = titles,
  date  = dates_clean,
  link  = links
)

view(articles)
```

## FUNCTION 1: SCRAPING INDIVIDUAL ARTICLE LINKS

```{r}
get_link_from_search <- function(page, css_code) {
  link <- page |>
    html_elements(css_code) |>
    html_attr("href")
}

scrape_list_links1 <- function(url) {
  Sys.sleep(3)
  session <- bow(url, force = TRUE)
  page <- scrape(session)
  list_links <- get_link_from_search(page, ".app-card-open__link")
  complete_link <- paste0("https://link.springer.com", list_links)
  list(complete_link)
}
```

## FUNCTION 2: USING LINKS TO GET INDIVIDUAL ARTICLE INFO

```{r}
get_info_from_page <- function(page, css_code) {
  page |>
    html_nodes(css_code) |>
    html_text()
}

scrape_individual_article <- function(x) {
  Sys.sleep(3)
  session <- bow(x, force = TRUE)
  page <- scrape(session)
  jcmr_title <- get_info_from_page(page, ".c-article-title")
  jcmr_vol <- get_info_from_page(page,
                            ".c-article-identifiers--cite-list .c-article-identifiers__item:nth-child(1)")
  jcmr_abstract <- get_info_from_page(page, "#Abs1-content p:nth-child(2)")
  jcmr_method <- get_info_from_page(page, "#Abs1-content p:nth-child(4)")
  jcmr_author <- get_info_from_page(page, "#main-content header")
  jcmr_type <- get_info_from_page(page, ".c-article-title+ .c-article-identifiers .c-article-identifiers__item:nth-child(1)")
  jcmr_date <- get_info_from_page(page, ".c-article-identifiers__item time")
  tibble(date = jcmr_date, title = jcmr_title, volume = jcmr_vol, authors = jcmr_author, type = jcmr_type, abstract = jcmr_abstract, method = jcmr_method)
}
```

KEYWORD 1: "MACHINE LEARNING" 3 PAGES OF WEBSITE

```{r}
# PAGE 1 - MACHINE LEARNING
pg1_ml <- scrape_list_links1("https://link.springer.com/search?query=machine+learning&content-type=Article&sortBy=relevance&search-within=Journal&facet-journal-id=12968&page=1")

# PAGE 2 - MACHINE LEARNING
pg2_ml <- scrape_list_links1("https://link.springer.com/search?query=machine+learning&content-type=Article&sortBy=relevance&search-within=Journal&facet-journal-id=12968&page=2")

# PAGE 3 - MACHINE LEARNING
pg3_ml <- scrape_list_links1("https://link.springer.com/search?query=machine+learning&content-type=Article&sortBy=relevance&search-within=Journal&facet-journal-id=12968&page=3")

# COMBINING THREE PAGES INTO ONE LIST OF LINKS (55 LINKS TOTAL)
ml <- list(pg1_ml, pg2_ml, pg3_ml)
clean_ml <- unlist(ml)
str(clean_ml)

# Scraping information from each individual article
details <- purrr::map(clean_ml, scrape_individual_article)
bind_rows(details)
```
